issues: Console a11y warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' for screen readers. Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add a DialogTitle to the lightbox modal.

BACKEND GET /api/staff/athlete/{id}/pain-report.recent_reports contains Recovery source (and Training in same list)
BACKEND GET /api/recovery/proofs?start_date&end_date filters by inclusive range (all returned proofs match today)

action_items: Optional/Low: Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden DialogTitle) inside the proof-lightbox Radix DialogContent to silence the accessibility warning printed in console.

Optional/Code quality: alerts_util dedup is by exact message string which includes the date_str and level — fine for same-day dedup. Consider also auto-resolving older PersistentPain alerts for the same athlete+region when a NEW (different level) severe report arrives, to avoid stacked Red alerts across days for the same chronic injury.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py daily-pain (~line 2826) constructs entries inline — consider extracting region aggregation into a helper to share with athlete pain-report. Function is ~160 lines and already touches 3 collections (training_sessions, daily_readiness, recovery_logs).

recovery_routes.py /recovery/proofs returns up to 20000 logs unbounded by limit/offset query params even though frontend uses 60-item pagination. Backend should accept ?limit&offset to avoid sending up to 20k proofs in one payload for a long competition season.

alerts_util.create_severe_pain_alerts catches no exception path for db.alerts.find_one / insert_one; caller in recovery_routes wraps in try/except (good), but server.py callers (readiness, session) do not — failure would 500 the user submission. Wrap calls with try/except logger.error to make alert-creation best-effort.
AthleteDetail.js: recent pain entries flatten 23 items without virtualization — fine for now but consider 'Load more' for very active athletes.
RecoveryProofsGallery.jsx lightbox DialogContent missing DialogTitle (Radix a11y warning).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all required selectors and flows

seed_data_creation: Submitted 3 recovery logs as Lucas Silva during tests: (1) Knee/Left/8 with TEST_ marker — created Red severe-pain alert, (2) Shoulder/Right/4 — verified NO alert, (3) Knee/Left/8 again — verified dedup (still 1 unresolved alert). These logs remain in db.recovery_logs and the alert remains in db.alerts (unresolved). The next iteration may want to resolve the test alert via staff UI or clear via DELETE /api/admin/clear-demo-data if desired.
